title: Ahasuerus
html_source:
Ahasuerus is a biblical figure who is King of Persia in the book of Esther (and Ezra and Daniel) and who is usually identified with Xerxes I (r. 486-485 BC).

There is also a legend that Ahasuerus is the true names of the Wandering Jew, he who taunted Christ on the way to the crucifixion and was compelled in return to walk the earth until the second coming.
